role_summary: Own P7: decide whether SQLite adds value beyond the structured evidence files and define the minimum faithful schema.
recommendation: SQLite is justified only as the operational join layer. For the evidence layer, loading the three JSON files as-is wins: preserve each document and record unchanged, then add typed projections, admission policy, deployment context, and measurement tables—never remodel heterogeneous claims into universal ranges.
why: The 13 verified and 17 quarantined records alone do not justify relational normalization.

The decisive missing query is: “For active crop run R, which five axes have an admitted, context- and measurement-compatible reference, and exactly why is each other axis blocked?” The files lack run, site, sensor, aggregation, and zoning facts.
Immutable JSON payloads preserve claim roles and prohibited uses; typed projections support indexing without rewriting meaning.
Policy rows make future admission of general horticultural evidence an UPDATE, while basis mappings prevent unit and time-window conflation.
sketch:
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE corpus_document (
  document_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  document_kind TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
    CHECK (document_kind IN ('verified','quarantine','collection_contract')),
  schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(content_sha256)=64),
  body_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(body_json)),
  loaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE admission_policy (
  corpus_class TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_status TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (evidence_status IN ('verified','quarantined')),
  admitted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (admitted IN (0,1)),
  rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (corpus_class, evidence_status)
) STRICT;

-- Current boundary; admitting general horticultural references later is one UPDATE.
INSERT INTO admission_policy VALUES
 ('crop_specific','verified',1,'Current verified crop evidence','2026-07-15'),
 ('common_human_health','verified',1,'Current common health evidence','2026-07-15'),
 ('common_public_air_quality','verified',1,'Current public-air evidence','2026-07-15'),
 ('common_site_environment','verified',1,'Current site-environment evidence','2026-07-15'),
 ('general_horticultural','verified',0,'Deferred corpus-boundary decision','2026-07-15'),
 ('crop_specific','quarantined',0,'Research queue only','2026-07-15'),
 ('general_horticultural','quarantined',0,'Research queue only','2026-07-15');

CREATE TABLE claim_record (
  claim_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES corpus_document(document_id),
  evidence_status TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (evidence_status IN ('verified','quarantined')),
  corpus_class TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject_scope TEXT,
  crop_code TEXT,
  axis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (axis IN
    ('air_temperature','relative_humidity','plant_light','particulate_matter','noise')),
  metric TEXT,
  claim_role TEXT CHECK (claim_role IS NULL OR claim_role IN
    ('comparative_best_tested_point','comparative_suitable_band',
     'author_recommended_target','disease_risk_condition','health_guideline',
     'public_forecast_band','public_alert_trigger','environmental_standard')),
  applicability_status TEXT,
  measurement_basis_text TEXT,
  allowed_use TEXT,
  prohibited_use TEXT,
  why_not_scoreable TEXT,
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json)),
  CHECK (
    (evidence_status='verified' AND claim_role IS NOT NULL
      AND measurement_basis_text IS NOT NULL
      AND allowed_use IS NOT NULL AND prohibited_use IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    (evidence_status='quarantined' AND why_not_scoreable IS NOT NULL)
  )
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX claim_lookup
  ON claim_record(axis, crop_code, evidence_status, claim_role, applicability_status);

CREATE TABLE quarantine_reason (
  reason_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  description TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE claim_quarantine_reason (
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES claim_record(claim_id),
  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quarantine_reason(reason_code),
  PRIMARY KEY (claim_id, reason_code)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE measurement_basis_type (
  basis_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  description TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE temporal_basis_type (
  temporal_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  description TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- One claim may have several components, e.g. PM2.5 annual and 24-hour means.
-- These are reviewed projections, not new thresholds; source_json_path provides traceability.
CREATE TABLE claim_basis (
  basis_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES claim_record(claim_id),
  quantity_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  unit TEXT NOT NULL,
  measurement_basis_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES measurement_basis_type(basis_code),
  temporal_basis_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES temporal_basis_type(temporal_code),
  window_seconds INTEGER CHECK (window_seconds IS NULL OR window_seconds > 0),
  sustain_seconds INTEGER CHECK (sustain_seconds IS NULL OR sustain_seconds > 0),
  source_json_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  projection_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(projection_json)),
  UNIQUE (claim_id, quantity_code, temporal_basis_code, source_json_path)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE claim_requirement (
  requirement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES claim_record(claim_id),
  requirement_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (requirement_kind IN
    ('deployment_fact','measurement_capability','manual_review')),
  requirement_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  match_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (match_mode IN
    ('must_exist','must_equal','compatible_basis','manual_review')),
  expected_json TEXT CHECK (expected_json IS NULL OR json_valid(expected_json)),
  source_json_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  blocking INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (blocking IN (0,1))
) STRICT;

CREATE VIEW admitted_claim AS
SELECT c.*
FROM claim_record c
JOIN admission_policy p
  ON p.corpus_class=c.corpus_class
 AND p.evidence_status=c.evidence_status
WHERE p.admitted=1;

CREATE TABLE site (
  site_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  indoor_or_outdoor TEXT NOT NULL,
  legal_zone_code TEXT,
  roadside INTEGER CHECK (roadside IS NULL OR roadside IN (0,1)),
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(metadata_json))
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE cultivation_zone (
  zone_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES site(site_id),
  zone_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(metadata_json))
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE crop_run (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  zone_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cultivation_zone(zone_id),
  crop_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  scientific_name TEXT,
  cultivar TEXT,
  growth_stage TEXT,
  transplant_or_sowing_date TEXT,
  canopy_height_m REAL,
  cultivation_system TEXT,
  lighting_source TEXT,
  lighting_schedule_json TEXT CHECK
    (lighting_schedule_json IS NULL OR json_valid(lighting_schedule_json)),
  treatment_or_control_id TEXT,
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  ended_at TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE sensor (
  sensor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  zone_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cultivation_zone(zone_id),
  sensor_model TEXT NOT NULL,
  serial_number TEXT,
  firmware_version TEXT,
  calibration_or_verification_date TEXT,
  certification_json TEXT CHECK
    (certification_json IS NULL OR json_valid(certification_json)),
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(metadata_json))
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE measurement_stream (
  stream_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor(sensor_id),
  axis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (axis IN
    ('air_temperature','relative_humidity','plant_light','particulate_matter','noise')),
  quantity_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  unit TEXT NOT NULL,
  measurement_basis_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES measurement_basis_type(basis_code),
  temporal_basis_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES temporal_basis_type(temporal_code),
  measurement_height_m REAL,
  location_role TEXT,
  integration_period_seconds INTEGER,
  time_weighting TEXT,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(metadata_json))
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE observation (
  stream_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES measurement_stream(stream_id),
  timestamp_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  raw_value REAL NOT NULL,
  quality_flag TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (stream_id, timestamp_utc)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

-- Deterministic evaluator output; never stores a score.
CREATE TABLE run_claim_evaluation (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES crop_run(run_id),
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES claim_record(claim_id),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN
    ('applicable_reference','blocked_missing_context','blocked_measurement_basis',
     'blocked_policy','manual_review_required','out_of_scope')),
  blockers_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(blockers_json)),
  evaluated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, claim_id)
) STRICT;

-- Concrete product query the source files cannot answer:
WITH five(axis) AS (
  VALUES ('air_temperature'),('relative_humidity'),('plant_light'),
         ('particulate_matter'),('noise')
), run AS (
  SELECT * FROM crop_run WHERE run_id=:run_id
)
SELECT f.axis,
       CASE
         WHEN count(c.claim_id)=0 THEN 'no_verified_evidence'
         WHEN sum(CASE WHEN e.state='applicable_reference' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0
           THEN 'reference_available'
         ELSE 'blocked'
       END AS ui_state,
       json_group_array(json_object(
         'claim_id',c.claim_id,
         'claim_role',c.claim_role,
         'evaluation_state',e.state,
         'blockers',json(e.blockers_json),
         'prohibited_use',c.prohibited_use
       )) AS details
FROM five f
CROSS JOIN run r
LEFT JOIN admitted_claim c
  ON c.axis=f.axis AND (c.crop_code=r.crop_code OR c.crop_code IS NULL)
LEFT JOIN run_claim_evaluation e
  ON e.run_id=r.run_id AND e.claim_id=c.claim_id
GROUP BY f.axis;

score_verdict.what_replaces_it_if_not: A five-axis state matrix: reference_available, blocked_missing_context, blocked_measurement_basis, manual_review_required, or no_verified_evidence. Each state displays claim_role, matched context, measurement window, allowed_use, prohibited_use, and blockers.

brief_corrections: The quarantine file defines 11 reason codes, not 8. Ten are used by records; site_context_missing is defined but unused.
Only verified records carry claim_role, applicability, measurement_basis, allowed_use, and prohibited_use. Quarantined records instead carry quarantine_reasons and why_not_scoreable.
There is no standalone typed temporal_basis field, and measurement_basis is Korean free text rather than an enum. Time basis is embedded across metric, value, and measurement_basis.
The lettuce study is a complete temperature×PPFD factorial with an interaction warning; calling temperature “confounded with PPFD” is technically inaccurate.
The collection contract does not yet require a certified PM device. It requires certification status, grade, and number to be stored, while the acceptable certification grade remains unresolved.
procurement_implications: Plant-light evaluation requires a 400–700 nm quantum/PPFD instrument and reconstructable DLI; lux remains optional and non-scoring.
Temperature and RH need co-located canopy-height measurement. Basil disease-risk work additionally requires a decision on in-canopy RH and leaf-wetness sensing.
PM requires both PM2.5 and PM10 plus paired RH/temperature and certification metadata; the minimum acceptable certification grade still needs selection.
Noise requires LAeq with integration period, maximum-level time weighting, calibration metadata, and site zoning/roadside facts.
assumptions: The MVP will join evidence to live deployment and sensor data, rather than remain a static reference viewer.
SQLite JSON1 is available, and imports preserve source hashes and exact payloads.
Typed basis and requirement projections receive human review before runtime use.
risks: Projection fields can drift from canonical JSON and silently change applicability.
Generic JSON requirements weaken database-level semantic enforcement.
A stale or permissive evaluator could present contextual anchors as judgments; evaluation must fail closed.
High-frequency observations or concurrent writers may eventually exceed comfortable SQLite operation.
cheap_validation: Run one in-memory SQLite smoke-test script: apply the DDL, import all 13 verified and 17 quarantined records, verify every reason FK, create a wasabi run with unknown zoning and only a lux stream, and assert plant_light is measurement-blocked while noise is context-blocked; expected runtime is under one hour.
change_mind_if: If the hackathon MVP will not store or query deployment, sensor, aggregation, or site-context data, I would drop the evidence database entirely and read the three JSON files directly.
